'''2026 Tatooine Regionals Mark Billings DS tdigwattv''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Billings]] at [[2026 Regional Championships]] (Tatooine).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mark Billings]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Regional Championships]]
* '''Stage:''' Tatooine
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
